what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Burundi in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4876 Burundian asylum seekers in South Africa, 7.5% of all asylum seekers from Burundi.
Refugees from Burundi, a separate group, live mostly in Tanzania, Rwanda, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in periods from 1995 to 2024, most recently with RED-TABARA.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2005 and 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1165 asylum seekers, and UNHCR reports no figure above zero for 2006.
The figure then rose, reaching its highest point, 7171, at the end of 2019.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
